intro: Applied AI Engineer at Snowflake, building the memory layer that lets AI agents actually operate on company data. Master's in Machine Learning (NLP) from Carnegie Mellon. Backend engineer for the years before that.
longIntro: At Snowflake I'm building representations for AI agent memory — knowledge graphs, extracted skills, table metadata and domain understanding — over structured and unstructured company data. Before that, an MS at CMU LTI working on LLM evaluation and multi-agent memory (MATM); an ML internship at Netflix on speech systems for synthetic dubbing; and years of backend at CRED and LinkedIn. I also build my own AI products on the side (see below).

highlights.summary: Representations for AI agent memory — knowledge graphs, skills, table metadata, domain extraction — over structured & unstructured company data.
LLM evaluation with granular human preference feedback under Dr. Fernando Diaz. Co-authored MATM on population-level trajectory sharing across agents.
Full-catalog audio retrieval for style / emotion transfer in synthetic dubbing.
highlights.impact: ~13% win rate in human preference for TTS

highlights.summary: Bill-payments platform at CRED (5M+ MAU). Account Protection team at LinkedIn.
